text:
Noah (AE): passing VantageRx to CS — deal signed today. 12mo, Dedicated 4xGPU + Hosted fallback. asks: Okta SCIM + two custom SAML claims (team, cost_center), 24mo audit retention, optional VPC peering. target go-live in ~5 weeks.
Priya (CSM): awesome — congrats. Noah, paste contract link and pilot notes here and I'll kick off onboarding.
Noah (AE): contract https://redwood.example/contract/VANTAGE-2026. Pilot summary: steady 120 rps, p95 generation ~190ms, used streaming + rerank, token spend ~0.95x estimate. They liked reranking stability.
Noah (AE): risks: 1) legal asking firm 24mo retention 2) custom attributes in their Okta mapping untested 3) compressed timeline w/ canary in week 3 if infra ok.
Priya (CSM): Arjun — can you validate SAML claim mapping and SCIM provisioning in a staging Dedicated tenant? also verify whether full audit logs can be exported and retained to the customer's S3 + KMS for 24 months.
Arjun (SRE): I can run a compatibility pass. I'll need Okta metadata or a dev admin invite. Audit export to S3 is supported; need to confirm KMS key policies and lifecycle rules. ETA 48-72h. If attribute transforms are non-standard, could need a small config change (~3 business days).
Laila (Support): I'll open support tickets for SSO/SCIM (SUP-20011) and audit export/retention (SUP-20012) and attach pilot logs + contract link. I'll tag eng-platform if we hit infra blockers.
Priya (CSM): owners & next steps: - Priya: onboarding owner + acceptance criteria doc + weekly cadence; - Arjun: SSO/SCIM compatibility report + retention export options (by +72h); - Laila: create and triage tickets by EOD; - Noah: share customer engineer contacts and confirm peering intent. Marking Renewal_Risk=medium until retention is signed off.
Arjun (SRE): testing plan: 1) request Okta metadata 2) validate SAML claim mapping in staging dedicated tenant 3) run SCIM provisioning dry-run 4) attempt audit export -> S3 w/ customer KMS handshake. I'll post findings here and call out any schema or runtime changes.
Laila (Support): Tickets created: SUP-20011 "VantageRx: SSO/SCIM validation" and SUP-20012 "VantageRx: Audit export/retention". Pinging eng-platform oncall; initial triage notes attached.
Priya (CSM): acceptance criteria (initial draft): ingest 100k tokens/day, p95 gen <220ms, successful SSO login with mapped claims, SCIM provisioning for groups/users, and archived logs accessible for 24 months. I'll refine after Arjun's report.
Noah (AE): customer also requested better cost breakdown per routing policy — logging as product feedback. I'll be the contact for exec updates if blockers appear.
Arjun (SRE): heads-up: if we need server-side claim transforms, that might push the canary by ~5 business days. I'll flag the impact in the report.
Laila (Support): @Arjun include minimal repro steps and any config diffs in SUP-20011 so eng-platform can pick up fast.
Priya (CSM): scheduling kickoff: propose Wed 10am PT in two business days. calendar-bot: please send invite to Priya, Arjun, Laila, Noah.
calendar-bot: "VantageRx onboarding kickoff" Wed 10:00 PT (Priya, Arjun, Laila, Noah) invite sent :bell:
Priya (CSM): recap: Noah to share eng contacts today, Arjun to post SSO/SCIM findings by 1834567320, Laila to update tickets with test results, Priya will publish acceptance criteria and run kickoff. Also capturing Renewal_Risk=medium and product feedback item for routing cost transparency.
Noah (AE): will send contacts and add customer SSO admin contact now. thanks team.
Priya (CSM): closing note — logging customer feedback: wants a per-route cost explainer in the console. I'll add to the product board and follow up post-onboarding baseline.
